Text.Text: I'm Anya Kell, with the Czerka survey. Yes, Czerka is working on a Republic world, and yes, we have a permit. Nobody ever wants to see the permit, but I do have work for you.
Here is the survey rate. Czerka always pays promptly when it smells a profit.
Both ores are high grade, and the bid just went up. Is that all ten Raw Arkoxit and ten Raw Jasioclase?

Ore. There is Arkoxit and Jasioclase under these plains, and Czerka wants to know how much before it bids for the mining rights. I need you to mine ten Raw Arkoxit and ten Raw Jasioclase from the veins on the Wild Plains or in the Canyon Crystal Fields, then bring all twenty samples to me here.
Good. Bring me ten Raw Arkoxit and ten Raw Jasioclase. You can get them from the ore veins on the Wild Plains or in the Canyon Crystal Fields of Dantooine.
I still need ten Raw Arkoxit and ten Raw Jasioclase. You can get them from the ore veins on the Wild Plains or in the Canyon Crystal Fields of Dantooine. Bring them to me when you have them all.
Here is the survey rate again. Thanks to you, my report is going to be very long.
These came from four different veins, so you listened. Is that all twelve Raw Keromber?

Yes, Keromber. It runs alongside the other two ores, and my instruments can't agree on how deep it goes. I need you to mine twelve Raw Keromber from the veins on the Wild Plains or in the Canyon Crystal Fields, from as many different veins as you can reach. Bring the samples back to me here.
Good. Bring me twelve Raw Keromber. You can get them from the ore veins on the Wild Plains or in the Canyon Crystal Fields of Dantooine.
I still need twelve Raw Keromber. You can get them from the ore veins on the Wild Plains or in the Canyon Crystal Fields of Dantooine. Bring them to me when you have them all.
Here is the survey rate, plus a little extra for the Dantari problem. I know what that walk is like.
This wood is dense, very dense. It would sell. Is that all eight Hyphae Wood?

Timber. The hyphae trees in the South Fields grow a wood that doesn't rot, and the Dantari won't let my crew anywhere near them. I need you to go to the South Fields, cut eight Hyphae Wood from the hyphae trees and bring it back to me here, so I can at least test it.
Good. Bring me eight Hyphae Wood. You can get them from the hyphae trees of the South Fields on Dantooine.
I still need eight Hyphae Wood. You can get them from the hyphae trees of the South Fields on Dantooine. Bring them to me when you have them all.
I promised it wouldn't be cheap, and it isn't. Here is your pay. The lab can afford it.
It is still cold to the touch, after all this time. Is that both pieces of Bol Leather?

Only one animal, the Mutated Ice Bol that roams the canyons. The lab thinks its hide insulates better than anything we manufacture. I need you to kill the Mutated Ice Bol, take two Bol Leather from it and bring them to me here. It may take more than one hunt, and I told the lab it wouldn't be cheap.
Good. Bring me two Bol Leather. You can get them from the Mutated Ice Bol of Dantooine's canyons.
I still need two Bol Leather. You can get them from the Mutated Ice Bol of Dantooine's canyons. Bring them to me when you have them all.
This pay comes out of my own pocket, and it is worth every bit. Thank you.
Real food at last. I'm going to eat a carrot in front of my whole crew. Is that six Carrots and three Cultured Butter?

Ration paste, and we are sick of it. I'm told the Dantari Hunters in the South Fields carry Carrots and a Cultured Butter they make themselves. I'm not proud of asking, but I need you to take six Carrots and three Cultured Butter from the Dantari Hunters and bring them to me here.
Good. Bring me six Carrots and three Cultured Butter. You can get them from the Dantari Hunters of the South Fields.
I still need six Carrots and three Cultured Butter. You can get them from the Dantari Hunters of the South Fields. Bring them to me when you have them all.
The camp cook wants to name a loaf after you, and I said no. Here is your pay instead.
The sacks are webbed but dry, so the flour will sift. Is that all six Bread Flour?

It could, if it had flour. The colony's flour store was raided, and the Hive Kinrath dragged the sacks away to line their nests. I know how that sounds. I need you to take six Bread Flour back from the Hive Kinrath, in the Kinrath Caves or the Forsaken Jungles, and bring it to me here.
Good. Bring me six Bread Flour. You can get them from the Hive Kinrath of Dantooine.
I still need six Bread Flour. You can get them from the Hive Kinrath of Dantooine. Bring them to me when you have them all.
That was the last of the food orders, I promise. Here is the survey rate.
These are ripe, so the lizards have good taste. Is that all six Tomatoes?

Tomatoes. The Voritor Lizards hoard them and carry them back to the Janta Caves, and nobody knows why a lizard wants a tomato. I need you to go into the Janta Caves, take six Tomatoes from the Voritor Lizards and bring them to me here on the Field Trail.
Good. Bring me six Tomatoes. You can get them from the Voritor Lizards of the Janta Caves.
I still need six Tomatoes. You can get them from the Voritor Lizards of the Janta Caves. Bring them to me when you have them all.
Goodbye, and good luck with the survey.
What else does the survey need?
Yes, that's all twenty samples.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll mine ten Raw Arkoxit and ten Raw Jasioclase.
No, I don't dig for Czerka.
What is Czerka surveying on Dantooine?
I have everything you asked for.
I do not have it all yet.
Remind me which ore samples you need.
Yes, that's all twelve Raw Keromber.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll bring you twelve Raw Keromber.
Not right now. I've done enough mining.
Are there any other ores you need sampled?
I have everything you asked for.
I do not have it all yet.
Remind me about the Keromber samples you need.
Yes, that's all eight Hyphae Wood.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll cut eight Hyphae Wood for you.
No, leave the Dantari their trees.
Does Czerka want anything besides ore?
I have everything you asked for.
I do not have it all yet.
Remind me about the Hyphae Wood you need.
Yes, that's both pieces of Bol Leather.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll bring you two Bol Leather.
No, that hide stays on the Bol.
Is Czerka's lab interested in the wildlife?
I have everything you asked for.
I do not have it all yet.
Remind me about the Bol Leather the lab wants.
Yes, six Carrots and three Cultured Butter.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll get six Carrots and three Cultured Butter.
No, you can eat your ration paste.
What does the survey camp eat?
I have everything you asked for.
I do not have it all yet.
Remind me what food the camp needs from the Dantari.
Yes, that's all six Bread Flour.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll bring you six Bread Flour.
No, I'm not robbing Kinrath nests.
Could the camp bake its own bread?
I have everything you asked for.
I do not have it all yet.
Remind me about the Bread Flour you need.
Yes, that's all six Tomatoes.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll bring you six Tomatoes.
No, let the lizards keep them.
Is there any other food the camp wants?
I have everything you asked for.
I do not have it all yet.
Remind me about the Tomatoes the camp wants.
